purpose: Everything that comes in and goes out, in order.
see: The list of movements by date. · Category, account and currency of each one. · Filters at the top.
do: Add a movement. · Edit or delete one by tapping it. · Filter by date, account or category. · Search by name.

faq.q: Can I record in another currency?
faq.a: Yes. Choose the currency when you create it and we convert it for your totals.

faq.q: I made a mistake in an amount.
faq.a: Tap the movement, fix it and save. The balances recalculate on their own.
